tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify --json "WITH stats AS (SELECT avg(f1) m1, stddev_pop(f1) s1, avg(f2) m2, stddev_pop(f2) s2, avg(f3) m3, stddev_pop(f3) s3, avg(f4) m4, stddev_pop(f4) s4 FROM raw_train_56ae89_1) SELECT m1,s1,m2,s2,m3,s3,m4,s4 FROM stats" 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Compute train mean and population std

tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify --json "SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM iceberg.information_schema.tables WHERE table_name LIKE '%56ae89%'" 2>&1 | tail -10

mkdir -p .tmp
hops sql --no-verify --json --limit 0 "WITH stats AS (SELECT avg(f1) m1, stddev_pop(f1) s1, avg(f2) m2, stddev_pop(f2) s2, avg(f3) m3, stddev_pop(f3) s3, avg(f4) m4, stddev_pop(f4) s4 FROM mlpab5a1eb8_featurestore.raw_train_56ae89_1), combined AS (SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM mlpab5a1eb8_featurestore.raw_train_56ae89_1 UNION ALL SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM mlpab5a1eb8_featurestore.raw_serve_56ae89_1) SELECT c.row_id, c.split, round((c.f1 - s.m1)/s.s1, 6) AS f1, round((c.f2 - s.m2)/s.s2, 6) AS f2, round((c.f3 - s.m3)/s.s3, 6) AS f3, round((c.f4 - s.m4)/s.s4, 6) AS f4 FROM combined c CROSS JOIN stats s ORDER BY c.split, c.row_id" > .tmp/scaled.json 2>.tmp/err.log
tail -3 .tmp/err.log
echo "=== rows ==="; grep -c row_id .tmp/scaled.json
echo "=== head ==="; head -20 .tmp/scaled.json
tool_input.description: Run standardization query, save JSON output

tool_input.command: for cat in hudi hive delta; do echo "=== $cat ==="; hops sql --no-verify --json --catalog $cat "SELECT count(*) c FROM mlpab5a1eb8_featurestore.raw_train_56ae89_1" 2>&1 | grep -E '"c"|name=|count' | head -3; done
tool_input.description: Test which catalog can read the FG table

tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --json --catalog delta --limit 0 "WITH stats AS (SELECT avg(f1) m1, stddev_pop(f1) s1, avg(f2) m2, stddev_pop(f2) s2, avg(f3) m3, stddev_pop(f3) s3, avg(f4) m4, stddev_pop(f4) s4 FROM mlpab5a1eb8_featurestore.raw_train_56ae89_1), combined AS (SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM mlpab5a1eb8_featurestore.raw_train_56ae89_1 UNION ALL SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM mlpab5a1eb8_featurestore.raw_serve_56ae89_1) SELECT c.row_id, c.split, round((c.f1 - s.m1)/s.s1, 6) AS f1, round((c.f2 - s.m2)/s.s2, 6) AS f2, round((c.f3 - s.m3)/s.s3, 6) AS f3, round((c.f4 - s.m4)/s.s4, 6) AS f4 FROM combined c CROSS JOIN stats s ORDER BY c.split, c.row_id" > .tmp/scaled.json 2>.tmp/err.log
tail -3 .tmp/err.log
echo "=== rows (row_id count) ==="; grep -c '"row_id"' .tmp/scaled.json
echo "=== head ==="; head -24 .tmp/scaled.json
tool_input.description: Run full standardization in Trino delta catalog

tool_input.command: hops fg create scaled56ae89 --version 1 --primary-key row_id --online --features "row_id:string,split:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double" --description "both splits standardized using train-only mean/population-std preprocessing" 2>&1 | tail -4
